entry.title: [様子見] npm: @hono/node-server: Unhandled `ECONNRESET` on the socket during an asynchronous WebSocket upgrade crashes the process (MEDIUM)
entry.content:
Claudeの仕分け：様子見 MEDIUM。WebSocket接続の切り替え中に接続が切れるとプロセスが落ちる
→ @hono/node-server 2.1.6 以降に更新

entry.title: [様子見] npm: @hono/node-server: Backslash in the request path is parsed as a path separator, bypassing path-based access control at a reverse proxy (MEDIUM)
entry.content:
Claudeの仕分け：様子見 MEDIUM。パスの\が区切りとして扱われ、リバースプロキシのパス制限を抜けられる
→ @hono/node-server 2.1.6 / 1.19.18 以降に更新

@hono/node-server >= 2.0.0, < 2.1.6 → 2.1.6, @hono/node-server < 1.19.18 → 1.19.18
